四個圓的總周長為

C_{\text{總}} = 2\pi(5+10+15+20)\ \text{cm}=2\pi\times50\ \text{cm}=100\pi\ \text{cm}\approx 314.16\ \text{cm}.
\]

We need to compute circumference for each: C = 2πr. Sum them: 2π(5+10+15+20) = 2π*50 = 100π cm. So numeric value: 100π ≈ 314.159265 cm. We can provide exact expression or approximate. The user didn't specify format. We can give answer in cm. Provide explanation.
